|translation='''Title:''' Special Modifications.<ref name="photo" />

'''Card text:''' Use 1 Force to deploy on any starship. Add 2 to its armor or maneuver. If deployed on the [[Millennium Falcon]] while [[Han Solo|Han]], [[Lando Calrissian|Lando]], or [[Chewbacca|Chewie]] is piloting, also add 2 to power and forfeit.<ref name="photo" />

'''Lore:''' Han's “special modifications” to the [[Millennium Falcon]] include added security equipment, defensive shields, hull armor, a faster hyperdrive, and improved weapons.<ref name="photo" />

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese retains the English printed cost and bonuses, including the additional power and forfeit bonus for [[Millennium Falcon]] with [[Han Solo|Han]], [[Lando Calrissian|Lando]], or [[Chewbacca|Chewie]] piloting.<ref name="photo" /><ref name="english-face">[[:File:Premiere-L-specialmodifications-decipher-archive.gif|Special Modifications original English printed face]].</ref>
